headline: DNY will send the revised menu costing by Friday, and Rakesh will share three months of vendor bills to bring food cost down from 41%.
executive_summary: Food cost is running at 41% against a 34% target, driven by paneer and dairy rates; the dairy bill alone was 1.8 lakh last month.

DNY sends the revised menu costing with portion sizes by Friday, keeping selling prices unchanged; Rakesh sends the last three months of vendor bills by tomorrow so DNY can negotiate rates, and they speak again on Monday.

language_profile.notes: Both sides spoke Hinglish; the dairy bill was said in lakh.

action_items.title: Send revised menu costing with portion sizes
action_items.details: Food cost is 41% against a 34% target. The revised costing keeps selling prices the same and brings the cost down through portion sizes and recipes.

due.basis: call on Wed 18 Nov; Friday = 20 Nov

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.quote: Aur main revised menu costing Friday tak bhej dungi, portion size ke saath.
evidence.quote_english: And I will send the revised menu costing by Friday, with portion sizes.

action_items.title: Share last three months of vendor bills
action_items.details: DNY asked for the bills to see where supplier rates can be negotiated; Rakesh will send them on WhatsApp.

due.basis: call on Wed 18 Nov; 'kal' for sending the bills = Thu 19 Nov

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Theek hai, main kal tak saare vendor bills WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon.
evidence.quote_english: Fine, I will send all the vendor bills on WhatsApp by tomorrow.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.quote: Isiliye mujhe aapke vendor bills chahiye, last teen mahine ke.
evidence.quote_english: That is why I need your vendor bills, for the last three months.

decisions.statement: Menu selling prices stay the same; food cost is brought down through portion sizes and recipes.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.quote: Bilkul, selling price same rakhenge, portion aur recipe se cost kam karenge.
evidence.quote_english: Of course, we will keep the selling price the same and bring the cost down through portions and recipes.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Bas dhyan rakhna ki dishes ke rate customer ke liye zyada na badhein.
evidence.quote_english: Just make sure the dish prices do not go up much for customers.

key_facts.fact: Food cost is 41% against a 34% target.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.quote: Abhi food cost 41 percent aa raha hai, target 34 percent ka hai.
evidence.quote_english: Food cost is now 41 percent; the target is 34 percent.

key_facts.fact: Last month's dairy bill alone was 1.8 lakh.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Pichhle mahine sirf dairy ka bill 1.8 lakh aaya tha.
evidence.quote_english: Last month the dairy bill alone came to 1.8 lakh.

risks.description: The dairy supplier raises its rates every month, which keeps pushing food cost up.
risks.mitigation_discussed: DNY reviews the vendor bills to see where rates can be negotiated.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Haan, dairy wala har mahine rate badha deta hai.
evidence.quote_english: Yes, the dairy supplier raises the rate every month.

next_meeting.raw_phrase: Monday ko phir call karte hain
next_meeting.purpose: Follow-up call to go through the revised costing.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Monday ko phir call karte hain, tab costing dekh lenge.
evidence.quote_english: Let us talk again on Monday; we will look at the costing then.

evidence.speaker: Speaker 2
evidence.quote: Haan, Monday ko main call karti hoon.
evidence.quote_english: Yes, I will call on Monday.

client_sentiment.label: positive
client_sentiment.summary: Rakesh was cooperative and agreed to send the bills at once; his one concern was that dish prices should not rise for customers.
drivers: agreed to share the vendor bills

evidence.speaker: Speaker 1
evidence.quote: Friday theek hai. Bas dhyan rakhna ki dishes ke rate customer ke liye zyada na badhein.
evidence.quote_english: Friday is fine. Just make sure the dish prices do not go up much for customers.

unresolved_references: 'kal tak' for the vendor bills is taken as the day after the call
